title: UBC International Scholars Program
official_source: The University of British Columbia (UBC) Undergraduate Admissions
description: UBC's International Scholars Program offers two prestigious awards to high academic achievers who are dedicated to giving back to their communities.

title: Donald A. Wehrung International Student Award (UBC International Scholars Program)
program_type: Need-and-merit-based undergraduate award within UBC's International Scholars Program, requiring high school nomination.
description: The Donald A. Wehrung International Student Award is one of four need-and-merit-based award categories in UBC's International Scholars Program. It recognises outstanding international undergraduates from impoverished or war-torn areas who have achieved academic excellence under challenging circumstances and would be unable to attend university without significant financial assistance, and who demonstrate leadership potential and a commitment to making a positive impact in their communities. title: McMaster University Award of Excellence (International Fee-Paying Students)
program_type: Entrance award for international fee-paying undergraduates, renewable across Levels 2 to 4.
duration: Four years, renewable each year in Levels 2 to 4 for a total of four years
description: The McMaster University Award of Excellence is McMaster's most prestigious international entrance award, valued at up to $200,000 over four years and renewable in Levels 2 to 4. It is open to international students paying international tuition fees who enter the Faculty of Business, Engineering, Humanities, Science or Social Sciences and who exemplify the highest standards of academic and personal achievement. title: York University President's International Scholarship of Excellence
program_type: Prestigious undergraduate entrance scholarship for international high school applicants
description: York University's President's International Scholarship of Excellence is awarded to international high-school applicants who demonstrate academic excellence, commitment to volunteer work and extracurricular activities, and leadership skills. Recipients, known as President's International Scholars, represent students of the highest academic calibre from around the world.

title: University of Waterloo International Student Entrance Scholarship
program_type: In most circumstances, students who receive OSAP are Canadian citizens, Permanent Residents, or a Protected Person and thus would not be eligible for the International Student Entrance Scholarship.
duration: You are not required to provide an English language test score if your four most recent years of full-time education have been in Canada .
description: International fee-paying students admitted to a full-time, first-year degree program at Waterloo. Students applying from CEGEP are eligible for the scholarship.
